_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro: Siz {player_id} o'yinchisiz {num_players} o'yinchi yolg'onchi zarlari o'yini. Qoidalar: - Sizning navbatingizda siz quyidagilarni amalga oshirishingiz mumkin: 1) joriy taklifdan yuqori miqdorda yoki yuqori yuz bilan yangi taklifni (yoki ikkalasi ham); ya'ni '[Bid: 3, 4]', 2) "[Call]" ni yozish orqali oxirgi taklifni chaqiring. Agar siz: - Agar barcha zarlar orasida ushbu yuz qiymatining haqiqiy soni taklifdan kam bo'lsa, oxirgi taklifchi bir zarni yo'qotadi. - Aks holda, chaqiruvchi bir zarni yo'qotadi. 0 zarga yetgan o'yinchi chiqarib tashlanadi. Oxirgi qolgan o'yinchi g'alaba qozonadi.

board.new_round: Yangi tur - Qolgan zarlar: {dice_summary} Sizning hozirgi zarlaringiz: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses: O'yinchi {current_player_id} chaqiradi! Aslida {face_value}ning soni {count}ga teng, ya'ni {quantity}dan kamroq. O'yinchi {loser_id} (oxirgi taklifchi) bitta zarni yo'qotadi.
call.caller_loses: O'yinchi {current_player_id} chaqiradi! {face_value}ning haqiqiy soni {count}, ya'ni >= {quantity}. O'yinchi {loser_id} (chaqiruvchi) bitta zarni yo'qotadi.

invalid_move.not_recognized: Amal '[Bid: X, Y]' yoki '[Call]' ga teng bo'lgan haqiqiy harakat sifatida tan olinmadi. Taqdim etilgan harakat: {action}

bid_reason.face_lower: Yangi nominal qiymat {new_face_value} hozirgi {current_face_value} dan past.
bid_reason.identical: Taklif hozirgi taklif bilan bir xil.
bid_reason.face_range: Nominal qiymat 1 va 6 orasida bo'lishi kerak.

message.eliminated_invalid: O'yinchi {player_id} haqiqiy bo'lmagan harakat bilan chiqarib tashlandi.
